title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
slides: Can Nvidia's credit back West Virginia's bet?
Nscale's AI data center needs a cosigner
Nvidia rarely puts its balance sheet behind partners
That signal may reprice AI infrastructure risk
Watch who signs next, not who builds
thread_text:
1. The cosigner question

Nvidia is weighing whether to guarantee a West Virginia AI data center. If it does, it's not just backing a building — it's underwriting the AI boom itself.

2. Why Nscale needs a backer

Building AI data centers is capital-intensive. A tenant like Nscale can't carry the risk alone, so it's looking for a credit partner with deep pockets.

3. Nvidia's rare move

Nvidia almost never puts its own balance sheet behind partners. Doing it here would signal that compute demand is solid enough to guarantee — a major shift.

4. Repricing the risk

If Nvidia guarantees one project, the market may reprice risk across all AI infrastructure. Other builders could demand similar backing, changing how these deals are structured.

5. Who signs next?

Watch the next company that gets Nvidia to cosign a data center. If more follow, it's a new playbook — and the real signal isn't who builds, it's who signs.

instagram.caption:
Nvidia might cosign a West Virginia AI data center — essentially guaranteeing someone else's loan, which it almost never does.

Nscale can't carry the build cost alone, so it needs a credit partner with deep pockets. 🏗️

Normally Nvidia keeps its balance sheet away from partners' projects.

If it signs here, the market may reprice risk across all AI infrastructure, and other builders will demand the same backing. 📉

For anyone publishing or building with AI tools, compute deals like this quietly set what access will cost later.

Who do you think gets the next cosign — and would you bet your roadmap on it? 🤔
